title: A citizen out after dark: wary, quick to alarm, eyes used to the dark
note: SANDBOX (by design: broad and diverse profiles, each with traits). Traits 0 to 1; SightRange in metres (daylight, open ground, a running body), ConeDegrees the half-angle, NoticeSeconds, MakeOutSeconds, ConcludeSeconds (each step up the ladder), HoldSeconds and CoolDownSeconds (calming down) in seconds (the proposed values).
